title: FakeAgent Claude Desktop redirect domain
description: A tool command URL or uniquely correlated network observation uses the reported FakeAgent redirect host. A command URL is a reference, not proof of traffic.
falsepositives: Threat research or IOC testing may mention this host in a command.
Domain ownership and content can change.
investigation: Confirm exact hostname, source field, network response, downloaded content, process execution, and user-approved scope. Preserve independent DNS, proxy, and endpoint telemetry.

classification.rationale: Contact with a malvertising redirect alone is not an ATLAS technique or OWASP LLM failure.
